name: Battlefield of Eternity
theme: Defeat the enemy Immortal in the center arena while defending your own to empower a massive lane push.
firstObjective: Warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00 (2:15 cooldown after a winning Immortal dies)
spawnPattern: Always spawns in the central arena between Top and Bottom lanes

mechanic.title: The Duel of the Immortals
mechanic.description: Two Immortals clash in the center arena while periodically casting dangerous AoE stuns and splash zones. At 50% health, they swap positions and reset their abilities. When one Immortal falls, the surviving Immortal regenerates health, gains shields scaled to its remaining HP percentage, and pushes the enemy's strongest lane—attacking at range until its shields break before switching to melee.

camps.name: Fallen Shaman / Bruiser Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top-mid and bottom-mid alcoves. The Fallen Shaman continuously summons demonic hounds until killed, making these camps exceptionally strong at pushing lanes if ignored.

camps.name: Khazra / Impaler Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left/top-right and bottom-left/bottom-right. Ranged spear-throwers that provide steady siege damage; easy to clear right before Immortal phases.

strategy: Because Battlefield of Eternity has only two lanes and no Boss camp, single-target sustained DPS and rotation timing heavily shape objective control. Capture Fallen Shaman camps right before Immortal spawns to force enemies between defending a pushing lane or losing the race. Race the enemy Immortal when your burn is faster, or peel and punish defenders caught in stun rings when defending your own.
notes: Because there are only two lanes and a shared central objective arena, rotation speed and lane-clear balance matter a lot—single-lane/offlane pressure can punish overcommitted Immortal races, while strong single-target burn lets teams melt the enemy Immortal quickly.
